description: Easy Code (formerly DeepV Code) — A highly customizable AI coding assistant compatible with all major AI models. The perfect alternative to Claude Code and Codex, offering deep code analysis, intelligent suggestions, version rollback, multi-device sync, and automated testing across multiple languages and platforms.
